j4q

Class J4Q

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.J4Q

  • public class J4Q
extends java.lang.Object
    Central utility and state class for the J4Q engine.

    Manages input devices, object registry, scene, physics engine, and haptic feedback controls.
